comment: The build log. One genuine dated line per entry, newest last; the build reverses it for display and for the Atom feed. Keep each to one line. This is the only pre-launch content the audience respects, so it stays honest.

entries.text: Name settled: Rennet. The enzyme that separates milk into curds and whey, adding nothing.
The v3 shell landed: a projects list, a narrated processing moment, the two-zone project landing, six reading angles.
The mark got its corrections: a solid bone half, an open backlit half, a hairline cut between them. It reads as divided at 16px.
This status page went up locally. No waitlist, no email capture, nothing to sign up for, because there is nothing to run yet.
